 The Men's First Team are back in UEFA Europa League action, this time taking on Stade Rennais at the Allianz Stadium on Matchday 3.
 Kick-off is scheduled for 18:45 CEST on Thursday, October 22. The Bianconeri won their first Europa League match 4-0 against NEC, and then beat Celta Vigo 2-1 in Galicia.
 Below is the list of players selected by Luciano Spalletti.
